widgets_values:
=== IMAGE-TO-IMAGE PiD UPSCALER v1.0 ===

WORKFLOW: Load Image -> VAE Encode -> KSampler (img2img) -> PiD Decode -> Save

--- UPSCALE OPTIONS ---

This workflow outputs BOTH 2X and 4X simultaneously.
Pick the one you want, or use both.

4X MODE (Top branch):
  Input: 512x512 image
  KSampler latent -> PiD Decode (scale=4)
  Output: 2048x2048
  Node: 'PiD Decode 4X (512->2048)'

2X MODE (Bottom branch):
  Input: 512x512 image
  KSampler latent -> PiD Decode (scale=2)
  Output: 1024x1024
  Node: 'PiD Decode 2X (512->1024)'

--- CUSTOM INPUT SIZES ---

For non-512 inputs, PiD scale works as:
  Input 256x256 + scale 4 -> 1024x1024
  Input 512x512 + scale 4 -> 2048x2048
  Input 512x512 + scale 2 -> 1024x1024
  Input 1024x1024 + scale 4 -> 4096x4096 (use 2kto4k ckpt)

--- REQUIRED MODELS ---

1. PiD 2K Checkpoint:
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/tree/main/checkpoints/PiD_res2k_sr4x_official_flux_distill_4step

2. PiD 2K-to-4K Checkpoint (for 1024->4096):
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/tree/main/checkpoints/PiD_res2kto4k_sr4x_official_flux_distill_4step

3. Flux VAE (optional fallback):
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/blob/main/checkpoints/ae.safetensors

4. Flux Checkpoint (place in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints):
   https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev

5. ComfyUI-PiD Custom Node:
   https://github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD
   Install: cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes &&
   git clone https://github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD.git &&
   cd ComfyUI-PiD && pip install -r requirements.txt

--- TIPS ---

- denoise=0.35: Gentle img2img, preserves composition, enhances details
- Increase denoise to 0.5-0.6 for more creative variation
- Decrease denoise to 0.2-0.3 for subtle enhancement only
- Set auto_download=true to fetch PiD checkpoints automatically
- Expected VRAM: ~13GB for 4X at 512 base
- Use sequential_offload if OOM errors occur

widgets_values:
=== KSampler Settings ===

seed: 8675309 (change or set to 'randomize')
steps: 20
cfg: 8.0
sampler: euler
scheduler: normal

CRITICAL: denoise=0.35

This is the img2img strength.

0.0 = no change (pointless)
0.35 = gentle enhancement (recommended)
0.5 = moderate change
0.75 = heavy change
1.0 = complete redraw
